frozen_note: The machine-proposed mutation space of record. Frozen BEFORE the priors call, the QRNG draw, and any arm measurement. Each arm is a single-keyword substitution in the lode engine's scout→extract KEYS lens (engine_run.mjs const KEYS, 14 entries). The runner hashes THIS arms array (canonical JSON, indent 1, trailing newline) into arms_sha256; registration.json pins that hash.
slot_recipe: Score each of the 14 baseline KEYS entries by CATALOG-corpus attestation (count of the 248 awesome-rsi catalog items whose JSON blob contains the key). Slots = the 4 lowest-attestation entries; ties broken by KEYS order (earlier first). Computed from receipts/baseline.json attestation (committed pre-registration): outer loop 0 (KEYS idx 5), reward-hacking 0 (idx 7), reward hacking 1 (idx 6), playbook 1 (idx 9) — map-elites (1, idx 12) loses the tie-break. Baseline-only diagnostics: no arm was measured pre-registration.
pool_recipe: Pool terms = the first 8 DISTINCT leaf ('###') section-heading vocabulary terms of the committed catalog receipt (run-6 review-c1-awesome-rsi-raw.md), in catalog appearance order, not covered by any baseline key, normalized to the engine's lowercase-substring key form. Headings cited per term below.
pairing_rule: Pool terms dealt to slots in slot order, two terms per slot: T1,T2→slot1; T3,T4→slot2; T5,T6→slot3; T7,T8→slot4.
